issuer: the Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR)
note: TMR's fees page (costs as at 1 July 2026, read 2026-10-30) gives the provisional, probationary and open driver licence at $94.65 for 1 year, $132.00 for 2, $163.25 for 3, $188.95 for 4 and $212.00 for 5, all held as terms the holder chooses, and a photo identification card at $82.70. The open licence page says one must be at least 20 for an open licence, so it is kept from 20. The photo card's term and youngest age weren't read (its page wasn't reached), so the term is null and the card has no age. On 2026-10-30 the file was rewritten with the terms the holder chooses among: until then it held the 5-year licence at $212.00 only.

sources.said: You must be at least 20 years old to be eligible for an open driver licence.
